title: GET /api/v1/my/heartbeats, 200
description: My::HeartbeatsController#index, my/heartbeats_controller.rb lines 26-38: the caller's heartbeats with start_time <= time <= end_time, oldest first, with no cap on the count, and their plain duration_seconds. pairtime answers with an empty list and the X-Pairtime-Note header instead (DESIGN 5.10), which this schema allows.
